title: Coil resistance calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate R_L = 2.0 Ω using the steady-state current from the graph and the circuit parameters.

title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the induced EMF at t2 as 3.0 V using the current from the graph and the total circuit resistance.

title: Current direction after opening
description: Important: The student must state that the current through the lamp after the switch opens is from right to left, applying Lenz's law to the decaying coil current.

title: Graph reading for currents
description: Important: The student must correctly extract the steady-state current (1.5 A) and the current at t2 (0.3 A) from the provided graph.

title: Application of Ohm's law
description: Important: The student must apply Ohm's law correctly for the LR circuit loop after the switch is opened, relating induced EMF to current and total resistance.

title: Steady-state circuit analysis
description: Optional: The student may show the initial steady-state analysis, recognizing the coil acts as a short circuit in DC steady state.

title: Sign error in EMF or current
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses a sign convention, leading to a negative EMF magnitude or wrong direction for the induced current.

title: Resistance summation error
description: Pitfall: The student omits one of the resistors (R_L, R, or R1) when calculating the total resistance for the induced EMF.
